query:
SELECT 'Companies' as table_name, id, name FROM companies
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Divisions', id, CONCAT(name, ' (companyId: ', companyId, ')') FROM divisions
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Departments', id, CONCAT(name, ' (divisionId: ', divisionId, ')') FROM departments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Teams', id, CONCAT(name, ' (departmentId: ', departmentId, ')') FROM companyTeams
LIMIT 50;
